user.title: Account operations
user.description: Staff actions for this account. Consequential changes require a second confirmation.

user.vacationDuration: Vacation mode lasts 14 days. The reason is recorded as an administrator-initiated vacation.
user.passwordResult: A password reset email was requested. No password is shown here.

password.title: Send password reset email?
password.message: The account owner will receive a password reset email. No password will be generated or displayed to staff.

reset.title: Reset this account?
reset.message: This is a destructive administrator action. Account progress may be removed. Add an audit reason if useful, then confirm only if this reset is intended.

vacation-start.title: Start 14-day vacation mode?
vacation-start.message: The account will be unable to log in during vacation mode. The current API records a fixed 14-day duration.

vacation-end.title: End vacation mode?
vacation-end.message: Vacation mode will end immediately for this account.

export.failed: The export could not be downloaded. Check your access and try again.
export.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid export. No file was downloaded.
